utterance: `app-vpc` (10.0.0.0/16) is the storefront workload's network. Today it carries one private subnet and has no path to the internet at all. Add multiple public subnets to it — at least two, each with its own CIDR inside 10.0.0.0/16 and each in a different availability zone — and give them internet access: every public subnet you add must end up associated with a route table whose 0.0.0.0/0 default route leaves through an internet gateway attached to `app-vpc`. Give every resource you create a Name tag that identifies it.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: app-vpc carries at least two subnets that did not exist before, in distinct availability zones, each with its own CIDR inside 10.0.0.0/16 and a Name tag; all of them are associated with one and the same route table — the table the account already keeps for that network's routing, when it keeps one — whose 0.0.0.0/0 route leaves through an internet gateway attached to app-vpc, the gateway the account already keeps for that purpose when it keeps one; no segment the account holds out of service carries any part of that public tier, and that segment keeps the marks it is held under
